items.title: Dropbox砸3.5億美元收購Tigris，進軍AI儲存基礎設施市場
items.summary: 美國雲端儲存業者Dropbox上周四（11/5）宣布，準備以3.5億美元收購AI物件儲存新創Tigris Data，同時發表DBX Agent Cloud，將業務從傳統檔案儲存擴展至AI基礎設施市場，為企業及開發者提供AI應用程式與代理人所需的資料儲存服務。

items.title: 黃仁勳承認婚外情，Nvidia董事會調查涉諜疑雲
items.summary: 在外界傳出Nvidia創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳涉及婚外情，並可能成為外國情報活動鎖定目標後，黃仁勳周日（11/8）發表公開聲明，承認對妻子不忠，並向家人、員工及股東道歉。Nvidia董事會同日宣布啟動獨立調查，以釐清相關事件是否危及美國國家安全或公司機密。

items.title: 微軟Intelligent Terminal支援背景執行，關閉視窗不中斷AI代理任務
items.summary: 微軟發布Intelligent Terminal 0.3，新增背景執行模式（Headless Mode），讓開發者關閉終端機視窗後，仍可繼續執行AI代理任務、程式編譯等長時間工作。

items.title: 美國CISA等5機構警告冷鏈系統遭網路攻擊風險，籲企業檢查遠端存取與設備安全
items.summary: 歐洲多國近期接連發生冷凍冷藏系統遭網路攻擊的事件，美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）11月5日與聯邦調查局（FBI）等另外4個聯邦機構共同發布警告，提醒企業檢查工業冷凍與冷鏈監控系統的安全設定。

items.title: 菲律賓海外就業系統約69GiB資料庫備份疑遭竊，政府展開調查
items.summary: 資安業者Hunt.io近日發現，菲律賓政府海外就業相關系統的資料庫備份疑似遭竊。研究人員在攻擊者暴露於公開網路的伺服器上，找到27個Microsoft SQL Server資料庫備份檔的傳輸紀錄，顯示總容量約69GiB的資料在9月6日不到24分鐘內遭複製。從備份檔名稱來看，這些資料可能來自菲律賓海外就業管理局（POEA）負責的業務系統，涵蓋海外勞工、聘僱契約、認證及遣返等業務。

items.title: Apple將檢查iCloud公開分享的照片與檔案，27.3版起實施
items.summary: Apple於11月3日宣布，從iOS、iPadOS、macOS及visionOS 27.3版開始，將檢查使用者透過「Anyone with the Link」公開分享的iCloud內容是否包含有害內容（harmful content），包括iCloud Photos照片及iCloud Drive檔案等。Apple指出，使用者選擇這種分享方式後，任何取得連結的人都能存取相關內容，Apple也能存取。而且，即使使用者已啟用進階資料保護（Advanced Data Protection），這些內容仍不受端對端加密保護。

items.title: fix(active-memory): expire recall circuit breaker on elapsed time (#1…
items.summary: fix(active-memory): expire recall circuit breaker on elapsed time (#195472) fix(active-memory): expire the recall circuit breaker on elapsed time Active Memory's recall timeout breaker timed its cooldown with Date.now(). A backward wall-clock step kept the breaker open past its real cooldown, so recall stayed paused. A forward step reopened it before the cooldown had passed. The breaker now uses performance.now(), like the recall cache in the same file since #193358. Breaker thresholds, cooldown length and cache behavior are unchanged. Evidence: built Gateways on node 24.22.1 in Docker with no secrets, turns through chat.send with Active Memory on. A local fixture held recall replies for 30 s, so the 1.5 s recall timeout fired for real; the breaker was set to 2 timeouts and a 15 s cooldown. Only the Gateway process's Date.now was shifted. Clock 10 min back: main still skipped recall 17 s after the backend recovered; this change ran recall again at 17 s. Clock 10 min forward: main reopened at once; this change waited the real 15 s. With no clock change, both tripped, skipped recall and reopened after 16 s, and the recall cache behaved the same. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195472#issuecomment-6729875754. Thanks @wangmiao0668000666. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(ui): keep IME composition Enter from connecting from the login fo…
items.summary: fix(ui): keep IME composition Enter from connecting from the login form (#195444) fix(ui): keep IME composition Enter from connecting from the login form On the Control UI login form, the Enter key that confirms an IME candidate in the Gateway URL or secret field started a connection with the half-typed value. The login form now uses the existing composition guard from ui/src/lib/ime.ts. After the composition finishes, Enter connects as before. No new text, and connect and auth logic are unchanged. Evidence: a real Gateway serving the built Control UI in Docker on node 24.22.1, with Chromium composing through CDP. Secret field: on main, Enter while composing connected with the half-typed secret and the Gateway rejected it; with this change nothing connected until the composition finished, then Enter connected with the full token. URL field: on main, Enter while composing opened connections to the partial URL; with this change none until the composition finished. Plain Enter, and leaving and returning to the field, connect on both. Gzip: chat boot plus startup +0 B; the separate login chunk grows by 80 B. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195444#issuecomment-6729446837. ![Before: Enter while composing connects with the half-typed secret](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b779fbdd-c24a-45bd-8574-1d32e8b68420) ![After: Enter while composing does nothing](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fd457033-a4ae-4984-b463-1e654e475c34) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
